name: Death Stranding 2: On The Beach - Digital Deluxe Edition
storyline: Eleven months after the events of the first game, Sam Porter Bridges lives in quiet isolation near the former US-Mexico border with his adopted daughter Lou. The United Cities of America is now fully connected via the Chiral Network, and automated delivery robots have rendered human porters obsolete. When mysterious portals called "plate gates" begin manifesting across the world, linking distant continents, Sam is drawn back into action. Fragile, his former ally, recruits him to venture through one such portal into Australia, where scattered survivors remain cut off from the rest of civilization, threatened by evolving ghostlike creatures, hostile bandits, and powerful machines. Sam and his companions aboard the tar-traversing ship DHV Magellan must cross an increasingly dangerous continent to connect its people before humanity faces extinction.
summary:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Death Stranding 2: On The Beach full game for PS5
• 48h early access
• Machine Gun [MP] (Lv.1) early unlock
• Patch 70: Quokka
• Patch 71: Chiral Cat
• Patch 72: Why Me?
• Battle Skeleton: Gold (Lv.1)(Lv.2)(Lv.3)
• Boost Skeleton: Gold (Lv.1)(Lv.2)(Lv.3)
• Bokka Skeleton: Gold (Lv.1)(Lv.2)(Lv.3)
